test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelled sentence.

options.text: The athlete ran quickly across the finish line.
The athaete ran quickly across the finish line.
The athlet ran quickly accross the finish line.
The athleite ran quickley across the finish line.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Athlete"** refers to a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise. (एथलीट)

 
 
• **Example:** The athlete trained for months to compete in the marathon.
 
 
 
• **"Quickly"** means at a fast pace; without delay. (तेजी से)
 
 
• **Example:** The child ran quickly to catch the bus.
 
 
 
• The sentence "The athlete ran quickly across the finish line." is correctly spelled and grammatically accurate.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**
